groq/openai-gpt-oss-20b.availability: Available on Groq Free Plan and paid plans; exact organization limits may differ from published defaults.

request_limits.note: Published Free Plan limits are a benchmark input, not a guarantee for a specific account.

groq/openai-gpt-oss-20b.tool_contract: Groq documents tool use, reasoning, JSON/object output, browser search, and code execution for openai/gpt-oss-20b. AutoDev still benchmarks role-contract compliance separately.

request_limits.note: Resolve the selected Groq model before comparing request-size limits.

groq/generic.tool_contract: Model-specific; benchmark the exact configured model.

openrouter/free.availability: Specific :free variants and providers change frequently; pin the exact model used by the benchmark.

request_limits.note: Free-model availability, context limits, and provider capacity remain model/provider specific.

openrouter/free.tool_contract: Capability-specific. The benchmark must pin a concrete :free model and record actual role-contract/tool behavior.

request_limits.note: Use OpenRouter model metadata for the exact model before comparing request-size limits.

ollama/local.availability: Local model files, runtime configuration, and host hardware dependent.

request_limits.note: Effective context may be constrained by the installed model/Modelfile/runtime settings; benchmark the actual local alias instead of assuming the upstream model maximum.

ollama/local.tool_contract: Depends on the exact local model and runtime. AutoDev measures role-contract compliance from the actual run.

ollama/cloud.availability: Ollama account, plan, and cloud-model availability dependent.

request_limits.note: Resolve the exact cloud model and account availability before live comparison.

ollama/cloud.tool_contract: Model-specific; benchmark the configured cloud model.

openai/codex-baseline.availability: Selected Codex/OpenAI profile and account allowance dependent.

request_limits.note: Use observed AutoDev/Codex telemetry rather than assigning one limit to every Codex profile.

openai/codex-baseline.tool_contract: Operational quality baseline/fallback; benchmark the selected profile rather than hard-coding one OpenAI model.
